item.tib: bsang brngan bsam 'grub yid bzhin nor bu'i myur lam tshe bsgrub
item.coloph: 'di ni rtog 'dod phyir bgyis kyang / lung las 'gal bar ma mchis pa/ gang 'dod phrin bcol zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dgos 'dod mang la gang 'tshos bya/ dmu rigs tshul gyis bzhengs pa'o/ zhing khams bkra shis bde legs shog/
